scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of exact finite-sample weighted covariance eigenspaces, Pearson mean, and fixed-alphabet asymptotic limit; standard-library exact checks are supporting finite evidence. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive known categorical probabilities; iid sampling; fixed number of categories for the asymptotic limit.

Earlier general finite-time Markov pair-count generating functions contain the complete moment information implicitly; the explicitly diagonalized probability-invariant eigenvalues, eigenspace formulas, and calibration are the assessed structural statement.
Potential historical coverage by older Markov-chain flux methods remains unresolved; independent priority and correctness checks are not claimed.
title: Distribution-free covariance spectrum and Pearson calibration for overlapping categorical pairs
